name: St. Stephen's
description:
St. Stephen's
This building is one of the oldest Episcopal churches in Michigan. St. Stephen’s parish was organized in 1844, and construction of the church began almost immediately. Hiram Raymond of Hamburg was the contractor, and building funds were solicited in the East and in Europe. Donations were received from Hamburg, Germany, the native city of some parishioners. The clean delicate lines of the church and the interesting tower make this one of the state’s most intriguing churches.
